# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's regional homepages serving Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland with localized news, sport, and cultural programming.

BBC's regional services provide dedicated coverage for the UK's nations, including Welsh-language (Cymru) and Scottish Gaelic (Alba) content. These homepages aggregate news, sports including rugby union and football, regional programming, and cultural content tailored to each nation's audiences.

## Key Topics

- Wales
- BBC Wales
- Scotland
- Northern Ireland
- Welsh-language media (Cymraeg)
- Scottish Gaelic (Alba)
- Regional news
- Rugby union
- Football
- Local news
- Welsh sports
- Regional broadcasting
- UK nations coverage
- Cultural programming

## Regional Homepages

- [BBC - Wales - Home](https://www.bbc.com/wales): BBC Wales regional homepage featuring news, sport, and Welsh programming
- [BBC - Scotland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/scotland): BBC Scotland regional homepage covering news, sport, and Scottish culture
- [BBC - Northern Ireland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/northernireland): BBC NI regional homepage with news, sport, Radio Ulster, and Gaelic Games

## Indigenous Language Services

- [BBC - Cymru - Home](https://www.bbc.com/cymru): BBC Cymru Welsh-language homepage with news, culture, and media content
- [BBC - Alba - Home](https://www.bbc.com/alba): BBC Alba Scottish Gaelic broadcasting with culture, music, and programming
